# Blue Key Mortgage (bluekeymortgage.ca)

Blue Key Mortgage is the practice of Ragini Domenichini, a licensed Mortgage
Agent Level 2 (FSRA licence M22004226) with BRX Mortgage Inc. (FSRA #13463), specializing in reverse
mortgages for Ontario homeowners aged 55+. Plain English education, free
no obligation consultations, and comparisons across four Canadian reverse mortgage lenders available
through BRX Mortgage Inc.: HomeEquity Bank (CHIP), Equitable Bank (Flex),
Bloom Financial and Home Trust. Reverse mortgages in Canada differ from US HECM rules.

Contact: 647-231-3910 · ragini@bluekeymortgage.ca

## Quick answers
- Can I lose my home with a reverse mortgage? Not because of the loan itself, as long as you keep up your property taxes, home insurance and upkeep.
- Who qualifies? Ontario homeowners 55+ (everyone on title), primary residence; amounts and approval set by the lender.
- Costs: interest accrues on the balance, set-up/appraisal/legal fees apply, and remaining equity decreases over time.
